title: Coping during COVID-19: family businesses and social assistance in Nigeria
publisher: Covid Economics: Vetted and Real-Time Papers 51, 159–184 (CEPR)
summary: The paper examines how changes in income and social assistance during the COVID-19 pandemic relate to the coping strategies of family business owners in Nigeria.
keyFindings: Family business owners who lost income were more likely to show a higher coping level.
Owners who received social assistance were also more likely to show a higher coping level.
methods: Nigeria Baseline COVID-19 National Longitudinal Phone Survey 2020 (World Bank high-frequency phone survey).
